crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: This sample is identified as the legitimate Windows administrative utility 'wecutil.exe' (WMI Event Collection Utility). It is used for managing Windows Event Forwarding (WEF) and event subscriptions. The binary's primary behaviors include using the Windows Event Collector API (e.g., EcOpenSubscription, EcSaveSubscription, EcEnumNextSubscription) to create, delete, and configure event subscriptions via XML and command-line arguments. It also interacts with the registry at 'SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\EventCollector' to manage runtime status and metadata. The presence of internal Microsoft source paths like 'admin\wmi\events\forwarding\common' further confirms its status as an official system component.
